messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for /v1/generate in prod (us-east-1). p95 jumped 120ms -> 2.1s, p99 -> 5.8s, 5xx rate 4.7%. Deploy api-serving v2.14.3 finished ~10m ago. Opening incident channel.
Alex: seeing same. Canary looks bad. Rolling back the canary now.
Priya: are customers seeing errors? any SLO breaches surfaced?
Sam: yes, multiple downstreams reporting gateway timeouts + 502s. SES shows surge started at ~3223456770. Impact on top traffic routes ~8%.
Alex: initiating rollback: `deploy-bot rollback api-serving v2.14.3 --env prod --canary` — status: in-progress.
Priya: can someone check kvcache/connection metrics? could be cache pressure or connection leak.
Eric: kvcache eviction count spiked around the same time as deploy. snippet from logs:
```
[kvcache] ts=3223456775 evictions=12482 inflight=312 miss_rate=0.36
[proxy] conn_pool_exhausted=48 keepalive_waiters=210
```
Nora: tagging runtime team. @kate can you look at the new kernel/epoll flags that went out with v2.14.3?
Kate: on it. Early eyeballing: v2.14.3 toggled epoll_batch=on in the binary + bumped keepalive timeout default. Could be causing backlog with high keepalive reuse. Reproducing locally.
Alex: rollback progress: pods terminating for v2.14.3, rollout -> v2.14.2.
Deploy-bot: Rollback started at 3223456790, 6/6 pods new version terminating.
Sam: telemetry after rollback start: 5xx -> 0.6%, p99 down to ~180ms. Good signal.
Priya: great, start incident timeline and customer-impact list. We need top 5 affected orgs for CS outreach.
Sam: ticket INC-2023-5692 created with initial notes and runbook links: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/timeout-regression. Adding logs + graphs.
Eric: taking pager for postmortem. Preserve logs, coredumps, netstat/traces on the effected nodes for 72h. Request infra to preserve node images and avoid autoscaling down.
Nora: infra notified — will set node-protect label and snapshot metrics.
Kate: spinning staging repro with v2.14.3 and load profile used by canary. Will test with keepalive-heavy workload and kvcache warmup patterns.
Alex: any other immediate mitigations? suggested temp mitigation: reduce keepalive reuse and backoff client-side for a few minutes. Not ideal but buys time.
Priya: also revisit alerting thresholds — p95 jumps should page differently from steady noise.
Sam: CS alerted; drafting outbound comms. ETA draft 30m.
Deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 3223456802, serving v2.14.2 restored across clusters.
Incident-bot: Handing off incident to oncall (eric) for root cause and postmortem.
Eric: acknowledged. I'll run GC/heap profiles, collect epoll stats, and schedule RCA meeting. Postmortem due within 48h.
Kate: after initial repro, toggling epoll_batch back to off in a sandbox eliminated backlog under identical load. Preliminary hypothesis: epoll batching + keepalive change provoked connection queueing and kvcache eviction ripple.
Priya: action items captured: 1) repro and confirm (Kate), 2) telemetry/alert tuning (Priya), 3) postmortem + timeline (Eric), 4) customer comms (Sam), 5) block change to epoll_batch in next deploy until verified (Alex).
Nora: monitoring shows stable for 10m post-rollback. Closing incident channel for now — reopen if metrics regress.
Sam: will follow up with CS for affected customers and paste final comms here. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks team — great rapid rollback. We'll align on mitigations in the RCA.
